name: baesian
description: Swipe review for agent decisions: agents file decision cards, a human answers them, verdicts flow back through git.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build --config client/vite.config.ts && vite build --config client/vite.config.ts --mode site --logLevel warn
scripts.prepack: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm run build
scripts.test:service: npm --prefix service run typecheck && npm --prefix service test
scripts.demo: vite build --config client/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && tsx scripts/demo.ts
scripts.readme-media: vite build --config client/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && tsx scripts/readme-media.ts
